'''Chorba Chuggers''' was a hidden [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], located in the dense [[Capra offworld quarter|offworld quarter]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Capra]]. It was located between an [[Unidentified electronics repair shop|electronics repair shop]] and a [[Unidentified fabric retailer|fabric shop]]. [[Dimbu]], was a [[Cragmoloid/Legends|Cragmoloid]] who served as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]].<ref name="SoR" />
